optimization_policy: No explicit whole-program LTO is enabled for any engine. Each engine retains its documented release-build defaults; optimization levels, CPU targeting and SWI-Prolog PGO are recorded rather than treated as identical compiler settings. Nemo retains Cargo release defaults, including any within-crate compiler optimization.
